expect_red: sweep: a feature is a point or an AXIS, and an axis is measured perpendicular -- which is the difference between placing the pitch arm and refusing it

mutations.contract: A bore locates a joint in two degrees of freedom and says nothing about the third, so the distance from a solved joint point to a fitted bore is the PERPENDICULAR distance to its axis -- not the distance to the point the fitter happened to return, which sits at the bore's mid-length.
mutations.note: The mutation drops the axis and measures to the point, which is what this shipped as. Measured consequence on the real run: the pitch arm's link bore fitted 4.57 mm along its own axis from the ball centre the solver reports, so the correct occurrence was refused at 4.57 mm against a 1 mm acceptance -- and five pitch arms stayed unplaceable while every point-feature check stayed green.
mutations.find:
var v = [target[0] - f.p[0], target[1] - f.p[1], target[2] - f.p[2]];
